source: Notion Lanebound - GDD / Champions v3.0 (gdd/lanebound-champions-v3.0.md); look from champions/portraits/painted/maelis/maelis-1024.png
note: Blue faces right and red faces left on the live map. Anchor is the foot point; blit at (round(sx)-9, round(sy)-23). Hit frames apply damage; projectile_spawn.offset is pixels from the foot anchor. Status follows the shared language: slow = drag at the feet, silence/stun = head plate (spectator/spec.md), root = wicks at the feet, sleep = eye at the head, mark = shoulder pin.

palette.note: Glass is lavender-white / violet; team tint only on the collar buckle and one cuff pixel.

idle.note: breath + glint runs up the vane

attack.note: shard flick: wind, flick, release a glass shard

skill.note: Q Prism Split: vane fans open, arm sweeps, prism line fires

veil.note: W Glass Veil: toss a shard high-forward; it shatters into a glass circle

ult.note: R Duskburst: vane unfolds a third blade overhead, dusk gathers, burst lands on frame 5

death.note: stagger, vane shatters, kneel, fall; last frame holds

slow.note: W Glass Veil 35% slow: drag chevrons at the feet, no head icon
slow.name: Glass Veil
